name: All seven instrument keys hide, repeat safely, and restore their own panels
Window shortcuts minimize, preserve Lab selection, and restore from the dock
Adaptation choice number keys retain their original behavior
Minimizing adaptations defers selection without losing choices or points
Editing a pet nickname never fires dock or instrument shortcuts
Dock opens only by F and auto-hides after five idle seconds even with focus
Dock can restore panels while the full HUD is hidden
F minimizes a modal before exposing the dock, keeping modal focus separate
Window buttons reach retained menus and repeated shortcuts toggle rather than stack
Photo minimization restores its camera and leaves no active photo state
System controls unlock at star scale and unavailable sandbox tools stay hidden
Workspace preferences round-trip through a checkpoint and remain independent per slot
Old saves receive a valid default layout and invalid panel names are rejected
Every-three-evolution save cadence stays atomic with workspace changes
Repeated restarts reset transient dock state without extra listeners or loops
Native Enter/Space activation on dock buttons is not turned into a propulsion burn
Pointer clicks do not pin the dock open after leaving it
Dock keyboard navigation never intercepts Tab for system overview
Dock disappears in main menu, pause, photo, and game over
